items.title: Dutch 'idealist' bank ASN blocks non-Google Android, including GrapheneOS
items.summary: ASN Bank has implemented a policy that restricts access to its banking services on non-Google Android devices, including privacy-focused alternatives like GrapheneOS. This decision raises significant concerns about user privacy and the implications for open-source mobile operating systems.

items.title: Blender's UI and Runtime: Much Faster Than GPUI
items.summary: A new update to Blender's user interface and runtime has significantly improved performance, making it faster than previous GPU implementations. This enhancement is crucial for developers and artists who rely on Blender for efficient rendering and animation workflows.

items.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
items.summary: A security vulnerability in Claude Code has been identified, where it inadvertently sends users' email addresses to external websites. This raises alarms for developers regarding user data protection and the importance of securing applications against such leaks.

items.title: We've built an open-source feature flag server for 11 years
items.summary: Unleash has celebrated 11 years of providing an open-source feature flag server, which allows developers to manage feature rollouts and experiments effectively. This tool is essential for teams looking to enhance their deployment strategies and improve user experiences.

items.title: MS Paint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: A newly discovered remote code execution vulnerability in MS Paint poses a significant risk to users, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code. Developers and IT professionals must prioritize patching this vulnerability to safeguard systems against potential exploits.
